title: Skill 使用教程
lead: 怎么跟 agent 说话、开哪种 mode、会留下哪些文件。示例默认收起，点开再看。

start.title: 这套 Skill 在干什么
start.body: Board Game Design 是一套 Agent Skill。由你给出约束和意图，它根据模式编写项目文件，并把 Locked 决定、evidence、experiment backlog 记在 design-state 里。它不是来聊天里堆一堆机制然后走人的。
start.habit: 第二次及以后开会，先说：read design-state first。

loop.title: 核心 loop
loop.note: 更新 design-state，再重复。Simulation 证明不了好玩。

checklist.title: Prompt checklist
items: 人数、时长、受众、目标手感
新开还是续作（续作先写 read design-state first）
要哪些产出、写到哪个目录
做实验时：一个变量 + success metric

modes.title: 六种 mode
modes.lead: 一次尽量只开一种。点开卡片看 sample prompt。

items.name: Create
items.do: 先比 2–4 个 chassis，再写 concept-brief、design-state、mechanism-skeleton。完整规则先别写。
items.example:
Design a 2-4 player, 45-minute medium-weight game about Mars colony logistics.
Target feel: scarcity tension, long-term planning, light conflict. Audience: hobby gamers.
Compare worker placement vs action drafting vs open market.
Write concept-brief, design-state, and mechanism-skeleton to ./mars-habitat/.
Do not write full rules yet.

items.name: Diagnose
items.do: 说出 symptom 和试玩事实，做 routing，再给一个可证伪的 hypothesis。别一次改三条规则。
items.example:
We've playtested 4 times (logs in ./orbital-mining/playtests/).
Leader is usually decided by round 3; trailing players say they can't catch up.
Read design-state first.
Diagnose snowball vs low agency vs endgame drag, propose one falsifiable hypothesis, and draft EXP-005.
Don't change three rules at once.

items.name: Experiment
items.do: 写清 baseline、只动一个变量、success metric 可测量。
items.example:
Set up EXP-002: test hand limit 3 to 2 only. Everything else stays v0.6.
Hypothesis: smaller hand increases discard-pile fights without adding AP.
Success: in 4/5 playtests, both players contest discard at least twice; fun >= 3.5/5.
Write experiment.md and a blank playtest-log for the next session.

items.name: Simulate
items.do: 问 win rate、时长、dominance。写 simulation-run。别把 sim 当「好玩」的证据。
items.example:
Run 1000 mixed-population simulations of Micro Scavenger with seed 42.
Focus on length and seat win rates.
Write simulation-run and mark that this is not a fun proof.

items.name: Balance
items.do: 用 value budget。写清 confidence 和依赖。
items.example:
Review CARD-014 through CARD-022 in ./deck-builder/components-sheet.md.
Build balance-spreadsheet rows using value-budget; flag any card where cost vs estimated value differs by >40%.
State confidence, calibration source, use scope, and interaction/combo/timing dependency for each estimate.

items.name: Prototype
items.do: 多数时候做 P4 paper PnP：rulebook draft、components sheet、checklist。
items.example:
Turn ./v0.5/mechanism-skeleton.md into a paper PnP:
rulebook-draft, components-sheet, pnp-checklist.
2-4p, 30 min, index-card prototype, no art.
Export cards.csv per tools/export-pipeline.md if batch cards are needed.
Run lint/checklist before finishing.

invariants.title: 硬约束
items: 先读 design-state。没有新 evidence，别重开 Locked。
每个 experiment 只动一个变量。
System evidence 不等于 experience evidence。
Simulation 冒尖了，也不能自动定案。

fidelity.title: Fidelity ladder
fidelity.lead: hypothesis 决定用哪一档。能便宜验证就别抬高。

kill.title: Kill gate
kill.body: 试玩够了，让 agent 跑 kill-criteria：continue、restructure，还是 pause。乐趣分一直低，多半该动 chassis，别堆装饰。

items.a: 不用。Design mode 只靠 Markdown。bgd-sim 是可选的。

items.q: 这等于 Building Blocks 原书吗？
items.a: 不等于。章节是综合后的取舍，不是原文 dump。想看原书请自己买。
游戏仓库要分享时，用项目级 .cursor/skills/board-game-design/。
不能。它答系统问题。好不好玩得人坐下来玩。
